scope: Read-only Chrome integration QA for 15m/1H/4H. No source changes, restarts, notification sends, private configuration reads, or raw OHLC stored in this artifact.

checks.evidence: Actual overview shows 15m + 1H + 4H; watch footer and runtime show 15m / 1H / 4H. Scan denominator 1,419 = 473 contracts × 3 periods.

Clicked BTC-USDT 15m from 全部合约 watch; returned to signal view with 15m selected. BTC search showed four USD/USDT historical 15m releases after those instruments warmed. Short filter yielded two short releases and was restored to all.

Selected actual BTC-USDT 15m market and historical signal. SVG aria label identified 120 real candles at 15m. Market x-axis labels included 9/7 22:45 and 9/8 08:45; selected signal axes included 9/6 08:45 and 9/7 04:30. Signal close display was 09/07 07:30, not rounded to the hour.

Actual BTC-USDT selections yielded interval=15 for 15m, interval=60 for 1H and interval=240 for 4H. Links were read from DOM, not opened. Unknown period fail-closed handling was separately statically verified before deployment.
Selected actual BTC-USDT 1H and 4H from watch. Correct filter selected, corresponding 120-candle chart loaded, and visible 0.00 zero axis remained in both.

All six MA paths retain original colors and width .8 with opacity .95. IMACD remains two lines with visible zero axis and no histogram. Selected 15m history renders only tv_start main arrows; long release near-zero 13 bars and short release 28 bars.

During first scan, eight early 15m windows including BTC/ETH reported awaiting_latest_confirmed_bar. System badge showed 部分异常 and count 8. BTC 15m watch showed 读取异常; detail explicitly stated awaiting_latest_confirmed_bar and chart hint 行情缓存已过期 · 等待重新同步. Cached real chart was presented as stale, not fresh.
Real 15m signal rows showed TG 历史记录 and Bark 历史记录. All fetched 15m records had history in both notification fields at artifact capture. No QA notification was sent.
Chrome error/warn log query returned [] after period switching and chart checks.
